action_classifications.description: Retrieves comprehensive user profile information and details from Linear by providing their email address as an identifier
Creates a new task or issue in your Linear workspace with customizable fields including title, description, assignee, priority, and other relevant attributes
Modifies an existing issue in Linear by updating its properties such as status, priority, assignee, description, or other relevant fields based on the issue ID
Fetches a collection of issues associated with a specific team in Linear, with options to filter by status, priority, assignee, and other criteria for targeted issue management
Obtains a comprehensive list of all projects within your Linear workspace, including their details, status, and associated metadata for project management purposes
Fetches a complete list of all teams configured in your Linear workspace along with their associated information, enabling team-based task organization and management
Retrieves detailed information about a specific issue in Linear by providing its unique issue ID, including its current status, assignee, comments, and all associated metadata

Retrieves all issues assigned to a specific Linear user. If no user ID is provided, retrieves issues for the authenticated user, including issue details such as status, priority, team, project, labels, and due date
Retrieves all users (members) from the Linear workspace, including their name, email, role, admin status, and last activity timestamp
Retrieves all workflow states for a team — use this to find valid state IDs for creating or updating issues. States include type, color, and position for correct ordering.
Retrieves all labels for a team — use this to find valid label IDs for creating or updating issues. Labels include color and parent group for rendering.
Adds a comment to a Linear issue with markdown support and optional threading for replies
Retrieves all comments on a Linear issue with full author details, edit timestamps, and thread structure
Retrieves the authenticated user's Linear inbox notifications, including issue assignments, mentions, comments, and status changes. Supports pagination and unread-only filtering.

Lists all Custom Views in the Linear workspace. Custom Views are saved filtered views of issues created by workspace members. Returns view name, description, icon, color, owner, and team scope. Use the returned view ID with Get View Issues to fetch the issues inside a view.

Opens a Linear Custom View and returns all issues matching that view's saved filters. Pass the view ID from Get Custom Views. Returns full issue details with state, assignee, labels, project, and pagination.
Full-text search across Linear issues and projects by title, description, or project name. Returns matching issues and projects in a single response.
